findings.title: Delta and QA undercount rows whose reconciliation fields changed
findings.impact: The corrected glossary and its links remain structurally correct, but the delta summary and author QA provide a false machine-readable count and therefore do not satisfy the correction packet's count-consistency acceptance rule.
findings.required_fix: Issue a new immutable correction packet. Report 28 reconciliation-field changed rows; if retaining the narrower value 10, label it explicitly as pattern-membership changed rows. Regenerate QA, output-manifest and handoff hashes while preserving the accepted glossary rows and byte-identical command register.
findings.required_retest: A fresh independent A3 reviewer must rehash the new packet, recompute both row counts from all seven reconciliation fields, and repeat the full source, terminology, objective and text-integrity review.

reviewer_stop: Freeze exactly six outputs in the assigned directory. Do not repair author files, update trackers, accept C3c, or start C4, lesson, app, Stage 3 or other downstream work.
